outline: 本課程將重點概述”奈米碳”，如富樂烯與奈米碳管在有機化學上所扮演的重要角色。教授內容涵蓋生活、物理及奈米科學，提供有興趣的學生選讀。
schedule:
1. Seeing is believing: Organic chemistry under microscopes (2 hrs)
2. Experimental skill training and discussion (3 hrs)
3. Synthetic carbon materials (2 hrs)
4. Experimental skill training and discussion (3 hrs)
5. A synthetic approach to gene (2 hrs)
6. Experimental skill training and discussion (2 hrs)
7. The nanoworld according to organic chemistry: Carbonaceous molecular bearing (2 hrs)
8. Final report (2 hrs)
